contract: Use lmsys/chatbot_arena_conversations at a pinned revision.
Deduplicate question_id to exactly 32,980 contexts and retain exactly 20 models.
Use released RoBERTa toxicity probability, TF-IDF plus 100-D truncated SVD, and turn index for p=102.
Use two-fold cross-fitted LightGBM nuisance predictions, two randomized-search iterations, and the published 10:1 weighted negative-sampling propensity protocol.
Compute plugin and EIF simultaneous intervals for weighted Borda, BT, and Rank Centrality.
Require plugin median interval width to be less than half the EIF width for every GARS.
Omitting the EIF correction must collapse back to plugin uncertainty.
